QuEST

Accelerate Bench task · Quantum circuits

QuEST simulates quantum circuits using state vectors and density matrices.

Task version3.1.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory8 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

The application executes every gate on generated circuits and returns the complete state and per-qubit measurement probabilities.

Correctness

Every amplitude or density-matrix entry and each measurement probability must agree with an independent simulator. The state must be normalized and repeatable.

Timing

Timing covers the full-state runner process for each generated circuit.

First-run rewards on benchmark v1.1, from the data behind paper Table 1, rounded to one decimal. Failed correctness is distinct from a correct result with zero speedup reward.
